name: malformed-findings
description: A scanner result carrying findings that violate the shared Finding schema (bad severity enum, missing required ruleId, negative line, wrong types). The TypeScript side must reject the whole round-trip as a protocol/shape error — it must NOT coerce the record into a pass, and it must NOT apply the Rust serde defaults silently. The Rust side (deny_unknown_fields + strict enum) rejects the same document with exit 64. Both sides: a malformed finding document is a protocol error, never a decision.
